nativeBuild.purpose: Original development-only warm PNG FFmpeg worker

receipt.boundary: Warm grayscale RGBA16 input with original alpha and hidden RGB to complete owned gray-alpha16 PNG: fresh managed MemoryStream creation/growth/public EncodePng/disposal, no redundant ToArray. Original adapter losslessly packs RGBA16 red/alpha with LE-to-BE word conversion into YA16BE on the pinned CPU inside every operation, into a reused prepared frame, then calls the FFmpeg PNG encoder; no native colorspace conversion; source/context/wrappers reused, real independent owned packet acquisition/encode/release included. Both level6/filter None/color4. Equal RGB fixed and independently validated; original alpha retained. Normal/scalar CLI encodes the identical canonical YA16BE bytes for untimed validation; native timed input stays RGBA64LE. IPC/file IO/hashes/validation excluded.
